scope: Executed independent same-space comparison of all six specified n32/r2 point-well finite-dimensional cases. The well intensity is explicitly normalized to one; the published rate is not recoverable. This record does not establish continuum exact-solution accuracy, singular energy convergence or original-author application execution.

reference.revision_scope: Verified upstream tag; executed installed extension is separately digested
reference.comparison_method: Independent Basix primal P2 and mixed RT0/P0 assembly with SciPy SuperLU full original uncondensed saddle
reference.source_access: Basix upstream release tag is verified; the executed installed extension is separately digested. The instrumented independent drivers, external code and native operator/field archives remain outside the versioned repository and release artifacts.

source.macro_partition: Incident-angle partition; each corner belongs to two macrotriangles with rates -0.5/-0.5 or +0.5/+0.5
source.primal: Actual nodal P2 point evaluation once per continuous local pressure mesh
source.mixed: Incident-angle allocation of the integrated rate to fine P0 pressure test cells

equations.physical: q=-K grad(p), div(q)=f, with the declared point functional acting on discrete tests
equations.full_original_saddle: A u+B lambda+h gamma=f_local; B.T u=0; h.T u=0
equations.primal: A_ij=integral K grad(phi_i).grad(phi_j); B is the oriented physical normal-flux pairing; f_local is the point functional
equations.mixed: (K^-1 q,v)-(p,div(v))+(alpha,v.normal)=0; -(div(q),w)=-(f,w); fine boundary normal integrals equal the constant oriented macroface flux
equations.orientation: Every macroface unit normal points outward from its first adjacent macrocell; physical trace lambda changes outward sign in the second neighbor
equations.prescribed_boundary: Zero exterior normal-flux trace; weak primal boundary convention, conforming mixed normal moments
equations.physical_gauge: Integral over the physical domain of p equals zero; no coefficient-average or material-weighted gauge

spaces.primal: Continuous nodal P2 within each four-triangle macro refinement, broken across macrofaces; raw Darcy flux is -K grad(p)
spaces.mixed: Contravariant-Piola Basix RT degree1 (RT0), fine P0 pressure, all executed fine-boundary pressure multipliers; original constant-per-macroface physical flux restriction retained
spaces.kernel: Constant local pressure; mixed kernel also has zero Darcy flux and constant fine-boundary pressure multipliers
spaces.kernel_verification: All 2048 original local blocks per case checked. Represented rank uses NumPy's default SVD threshold; positive K and connected local spaces supply the exact constant-kernel argument. This check is not an inf-sup proof.

quadrature.convention: Positive four-point Gauss-Legendre rule in each coordinate of an independent triangle Duffy map; native reference weights sum to 0.5
quadrature.adequacy: Material is constant on each original fine triangle; P2 squared pressure has degree4, gradient/RT0 squared flux degree2, so the stated positive rule integrates the polynomial discrete norms exactly up to floating-point arithmetic

norms.pressure: Broken physical L2 over all original fine triangles
norms.raw_gradient: Broken physical L2 of the raw pressure gradient for P2 only
norms.darcy_flux: Broken physical vector L2 of q=-K grad(p) for P2 or Piola RT0 q
norms.interfaces: Independent one-sided macrocell values; no averaging

native_arithmetic.operator: Archived float64 original operator fixed throughout solve and controls
native_arithmetic.backend: SciPy SuperLU double-precision factorization and backend RHS
native_arithmetic.precision: Explicit extended original forcing/residual/correction accumulation uniformly selected for all six references
native_arithmetic.coefficient_storage: Portable float64 high/correction/tail components with host precision guard
native_arithmetic.policy: At least one same-original-operator represented-defect correction unless the defect is exactly zero; the precision policy is independent of candidate agreement or expected fields
native_arithmetic.physical_residual: Original local physical rows and global weak trace equations divided by the norm of the complete original point-functional load; artificial gauge loads excluded
native_arithmetic.additional_precision_control: One further same-operator correction uses only native archives and compares native physical field norms; no candidate data is read

conservation.primal: Macro conservation from the constant local test; no fine-cell H(div) or pointwise exterior-normal-flux claim for the raw gradient
conservation.mixed: Fine-cell integrated divergence equals its allocated point-functional rate; macroface normal conformity retains the original constant trace restriction

runtime.resource_scope: Serial one-worker/one-thread acquisitions on a shared host. Timings cover the acquisition body: geometry/basis setup, assembly, solve, checks and archive; interpreter/module startup is excluded. Peak RSS is the driver process maximum since startup, rather than incremental case memory. CPU-only execution; no device transfer or synchronization costs. No speedup claim.

verification.native_archive_replay: Actual archived basis and complete original coefficients; no new basis or factorization
verification.coordinate_comparison: P2 actual physical nodal correspondence; RT0 actual archived affine Piola basis evaluated in independently oriented physical normal moments
